maintenance: Every provider behavior a finding relies on must trace to the source URL in the same entry. Verification dates record when the source was checked (2026-09-03). Re-verify all sources and dates before submission. Never encode undocumented product-to-backend mappings or GEO-vendor claims.

render_evidence.evidence: Googlebot renders JavaScript with the Web Rendering Service and AI features are built into Search; the robots.txt directives for Googlebot are the stated control.
Bingbot renders JavaScript; Copilot inherits the Bing index. noarchive/nocache semantics below are Bing-documented.
PerplexityBot fetches raw HTML and does not execute JavaScript (measured among AI crawlers requesting but not executing JS assets).
GPTBot fetches JS assets in ~11.5% of hits and executes none; content in the initial HTML (including inline JSON/state payloads) remains readable.
Third-party tests report OAI-SearchBot does not render; no vendor documentation states either way. Carry surface-scoped findings at medium confidence and say so.
ClaudeBot fetches JS assets in ~23.8% of hits and executes none.
No first-party or strong third-party evidence documents whether Claude-SearchBot renders. Treat render-gap findings for this surface as medium confidence.
ChatGPT-User performs user-triggered fetches; no vendor documentation on rendering. Name this surface only for robots-reach effects on the live fetch.
Claude-User performs user-triggered fetches and honors robots.txt; no vendor documentation on rendering.
Perplexity-User performs user-triggered fetches and generally ignores robots.txt; no vendor documentation on rendering.

surface_taxonomy.rule: affected_surfaces in findings may name citation + live-fetch surfaces only. Training surfaces are evidence for robots-policy findings, never an affected surface.

inline_state_caveat: AI crawlers may still index content included in the initial HTML response, such as JSON data or delayed React Server Components. A fact present only inside __NEXT_DATA__/RSC/state payloads is PARTIALLY READABLE, not lost: severity medium, acceptance test 'the fact appears in visible raw text, not only in an inline script'.

crawler_roles.notes: Blocking this agent is the documented ChatGPT-search exclusion mechanism; see verbatim_quotes[0].
User-initiated fetches: robots.txt rules may not apply; not used to determine Search inclusion. A Disallow against it does not remove ChatGPT search citations.

All three Anthropic agents honor robots.txt - unlike OpenAI/Perplexity user-fetchers. A Disallow against Claude-User removes Claude's live fetch; the same rule against ChatGPT-User or Perplexity-User probably does nothing. Severity and wording must differ.
Renders via the Web Rendering Service; sole access control for AI Overviews / AI Mode. noindex/nosnippet/max-snippet/data-nosnippet are the stated snippet/information controls.

A standalone robots product token controlling downstream Gemini/Vertex use of content Google has already crawled. It has NO HTTP User-Agent string - never include it in UA probes - and does not impact Google Search inclusion.
Renders JavaScript; Bing index feeds Copilot. noarchive/nocache meta/X-Robots-Tag directives have documented Copilot-answer semantics - see snippet_controls.

snippet_controls.effect: Will not be included in Bing Chat answers, not be linked to in the answers; will still appear in Bing's search results. Commonly shipped by paywalled/news sites for unrelated reasons.
snippet_controls.fix_hint: If the intent was to prevent caching, nocache preserves ordinary listing behavior without the Copilot exclusion.

snippet_controls.effect: May be included in Bing Chat answers, with only URL/Snippet/Title displayed; will still appear in Bing's search results.
Documented control for limiting information shown from pages in Search; listed by Google's AI-features doc as the way to limit what AI Overviews / AI Mode can show.
snippet_controls.severity_hint: high, surface-scoped to Google AI features; not critical (the search listing survives)

snippet_controls.effect: Same as nosnippet but scoped to the wrapped text span; check whether decision-page facts are wrapped.
snippet_controls.severity_hint: high when it covers a decision fact, surface-scoped to Google AI features

snippet_controls.effect: Bounds snippet length; max-snippet:0 is equivalent to nosnippet for AI-feature quotability.
snippet_controls.severity_hint: high at 0, medium at restrictive values, surface-scoped to Google AI features

snippet_controls.effect: Full exclusion from Google Search and therefore AI Overviews / AI Mode. A genuine blocker when present on an important public page - but verify it is not intentional (staging, duplicates).
snippet_controls.severity_hint: critical-to-high when on an important page, requires the access skill's gate

verbatim_quotes.text: will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers, though can still appear as navigational links
verbatim_quotes.use_in: OAI-SearchBot disallow findings - documented mechanism, not inference

verbatim_quotes.text: not used to determine whether content may appear in Search
verbatim_quotes.use_in: blocking ChatGPT-User does not affect ChatGPT search citations

verbatim_quotes.text: There are no additional requirements to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode, nor other special optimizations necessary
verbatim_quotes.use_in: README defense of the evidence-first audit against checklist audits

verbatim_quotes.text: To limit the information shown from your pages in Search, use nosnippet, data-nosnippet, max-snippet, or noindex controls
doesn't have a separate HTTP request user agent string
does not impact a site's inclusion in Google Search
You don't need to create new machine readable files, AI text files, or markup
verbatim_quotes.use_in: keeping llms.txt a low, docs-scoped opportunity - never discoverability

ua_probe_policy: Probe with a bot token's UA only on paths robots.txt allows for that token (homepage only); if disallowed, the robots rule itself is the finding and no probe is run. A challenged response is distinguished from an origin 403 by cf-mitigated headers and by content-type text/html even when robots.txt or sitemap.xml was requested. Spoofed-UA differentials cap at medium confidence (see severity_model.md).
